question:
If the given figure line I is parallel to m and t is the transversal. Find the measure of angle x.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e714a40a54d84928b2a34f8dd02b7ef28468dc8e99cb132d16c16abac248e77.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**60°**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given figure, **lines l and m are parallel, and t is the transversal**. We are given that one of the angles formed by the transversal and the **parallel lines is 120∘.**
 
• Since l is parallel to m, the angles formed by the transversal t and the parallel lines have special relationships due to the properties of parallel lines and transversals.
 
• Specifically, the **corresponding angles are equal, and the alternate interior angles are equal.**
 
• Additionally, consecutive interior angles (also known as co-interior or same-side interior angles) are supplementary, meaning they add up to 180∘.
 
• Given the** angle of 120∘**, we can determine the measure of x:
 
 
• **Angle x = 180∘ − 120∘ = 60∘.**
 
 
 
• **Therefore, the measure of angle x is 60∘ .**
